scope: Serial local forward single-cut comparisons; complete pipeline CPU/wall timings, not full-dataset accuracy or cluster throughput.
limits: Baseline 9cd89b0f is the immediate pre-placement-compression implementation; it is distinct from historical baseline 2e99e989.
Three repetitions per revision and case; each isolated process performs one cold run and one warm repeat.
Pipeline timings exclude imports and input loading; process_wall_seconds includes the complete worker lifetime.
Peak RSS is the complete process lifetime high-water mark, including imports, inputs and earlier repeats; it is not a per-stage allocation measurement or a bound for other cases.
Warm runs reuse matching preparation and cache; reduction, decoding and publication are repeated.
Branch caps count representative continuations; equal family counts do not establish equal retained mapping scope.
EnzymeMap 10383 retains wider capped placement relationships and is slower in both cold and warm complete-pipeline timing.
EnzymeMap 37270 returns zero baseline families and 100 candidate families, so its returned-output timing is not comparable.
All workers completed without execution errors; scientific cap and stalled records remain in the results.
The timed study did not hash complete scientific output; independent oracle and separate whole-record hash checks are reported in the README.
No universal speedup, complete mapping enumeration, full-dataset recovery or cluster-throughput claim.
Repeated per-state stop records are consolidated by reason and cap stage; aggregate counts, cap occurrences, limits and maximum attempted counts are preserved.
